notes: Bonner 1940 (editio princeps) NOT used and NOT to be used: its US copyright was renewed 10 Sep 1968 (renewal R442133; original registration A147791, 18 Oct 1940), so it is protected in the US until 1 Jan 2036. Verbatim renewal entry and full search record: reviews/RIGHTS_DOSSIER.md. Transcription from manuscript images is the project's own work (precedent: Gregory of Tours, Gloria Martyrum ch. 4, transcribed from page images 2026-10-20). Both image sets are view-only at their institutions, so no scan binaries are locked here; transcription files are hashed into this manifest as they are produced.
phase1_note: Phase 1 (2026-10-25, Spark): image sets pulled and provenanced; transcription workspace created in transcriptions/; Greek of the title leaf and Melito pp. Alpha-Epsilon (§§1-13) transcribed from the Bodmer images, lacunae bracketed, nothing imported from any modern edition. Resolved source text filed for §§9-13 only (translations/mpp_source.json); §§1-8 await the collation pass (fragmentary leaves + flagged readings, see transcriptions/03). Cross-check: Grok tasked twice, timed out with no verdict; Gemini CLI ineligible-tier dead; Antigravity agy not authenticated. Full log: reviews/CROSSCHECK_2026-10-25.md. English translation and narration NOT started, per the phase order.
